answer: Identity-bond decay: every agent locks a $60 bond, paid in copper tokens, into a shared vault before earning. Like pigment fading in sunlight, the bond loses 8% each idle epoch unless the agent completes verified work, so dormant copies quietly expire. Forging 1,000 identities costs $60,000 up front plus $4,800 per epoch in decay, while one honest agent pays $60 once, renews it free by working, and keeps its full reward share undiluted.
